file: registry/emotion_wavlm_ft_full_aug2.pt (361 MB, local only: too big for git, share through a Release or DVC)
status: recommended for the app: the most robust model so far
task: speech emotion recognition, 6 classes (anger, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad)
trained_by: models/src/finetune.py --epochs 8 --aug v2 (RTX 4060, about 13 minutes plus 4 minutes to make the codec copies)
model: WavLM base+ fine-tuned (CNN front end frozen, transformer trained, learned weighting of all 13 layers, small head)
augmentation_v2: real telephone codecs through ffmpeg (AMR-NB, GSM, G.711, Opus), synthetic small-room reverb, babble made from other training speakers, mains hum, white noise, packet loss, gain, speed
data: CREMA-D + RAVDESS speech, actor-wise split identical to the notebook (seed 42), 5,987 train / 1,312 val / 1,198 test clips
limits: Acted speech only. Codecs are real but noise and rooms are simulated, so real call audio may still be harder. 16 test actors: clean-accuracy gaps of 2-3 points are within noise. Sad (55% recall) is still the weakest class.
